{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication: should now have 800 unique patient_ids
assert data_dedup['patient_id'].nunique() == 800, "Deduplication failed: expected 800 unique patients"

# Check the sites after deduplication
sites_after_dedup = data_dedup['site'].unique()
print(sites_after_dedup)"}
